newsitem.title: USA: Motorola signs $53 mln CDMA contract.
newsitem.headline: Motorola signs $53 mln CDMA contract.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Tuesday it signed a $53 million contract with Bell Atlantic NYNEX Mobile (BANM) to upgrade the company's wireless communications network in Phoenix and Charlotte.
The contract includes the installation of CDMA (code division multiple access) technology, Motorola said.
BANM was formed in July through the combination of Bell Atlantic Corp's and NYNEX Corp's cellular operations.

Motorola's SC 9650 base station will be installed. It supports both analog and digital frequencies, the company said. The service will include voice encoder technology, which improves call quality by largely eliminating static and cross-talk, it said.
Motorola said CDMA service will be offered in the two areas in early 1997.
